name: org.mhkose.sdk.corerefs
displayName: Moorhuhn Kart Open Source SDK Core References
description: Stand-ins for the base content definitions with the GUIDs of the game's assets, so a mod can refer to core karts, tracks, characters, cups, powerups and effects. The game resolves them by id when the mod loads. Generated by the game project (MHK > SDK > Export Core References), never installed in it.
